design_system.name: Isotope
design_system.description: A bioluminescent, data-first design system that merges clinical precision with organic vitality. It uses deep dark backgrounds to make data 'glow' like biological markers under a microscope.

amino_acid_radar.description: Use a Radar Chart to show protein completeness. The 9 essential amino acids form the axes. A full web = complete protein.

instructions_to_main_agent: INSTALL_DEPENDENCIES: yarn add recharts framer-motion lucide-react clsx tailwind-merge @radix-ui/react-slot @radix-ui/react-progress
THEME_SETUP: Enforce 'dark' class on the html/body tag permanently. This is a dark-mode only app.
FONT_SETUP: Add the Google Fonts import for 'Syne' and 'Manrope' to the index.css file immediately.
CHART_RULE: Customize Recharts components. Remove all default grids/axes unless necessary. Use thin lines and distinct colors.
COMPONENT_OVERRIDE: Do not use default Shadcn cards. Create a custom 'GlassCard' component using the classes defined in design_system.components.cards.
RADAR_CHART: Implement a 'AminoAcidProfile' component using Recharts RadarChart. This is the core unique feature. It must look like a biological web.
PROTEIN_COMPLETE_INDICATOR: When a food is 'Incomplete' protein, show a warning icon with a 'Missing: [Amino Acid Name]' tooltip.
TESTING: Add data-testid to all interactive elements (buttons, inputs, cards).
universal_guidelines: Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters.
NEVER use AI assistant Emoji characters.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable.
